subject: SIG intake: architecture proof & artifact onboarding for CloudCrest RFI
body:
From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@cloudcrest.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CloudCrest SIG intake: request for control substantiation and onboarding artifacts

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. We're formalizing the SIG intake for CloudCrest's evaluation and need a short mapping and artifact handoff to proceed to procurement. Specifically: 

- A control crosswalk mapping SIG v2027 to SOC 2/ISO 27001 where applicable (spreadsheet preferred).
- Samples or exports demonstrating encryption at-rest and KMS usage for customer keys (redacted as needed).
- Example audit-trail samples that show retention and immutability for a 30-day window.
- A deployment/network diagram showing VPC segmentation and data flow between control plane and private instances.

Do you have a rough ETA for the mapping and what artifacts you can provide? We need the materials by EOD 2028-06-13 to keep the RFP timeline.

I'm happy to set a 30-min intake call tomorrow afternoon if that's easier. Attached is our intake template (CloudCrest-RFI-v1.xlsx) — we'll use that for alignment.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Sourcing Manager
CloudCrest Financial
procurement@cloudcrest.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@cloudcrest.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCrest SIG intake: request for control substantiation and onboarding artifacts

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass crosswalk: redwood-sig-crosswalk-v1.xlsx. It covers SIG->SOC2/ISO mapping at a high level with owners for each row.

Short answers up front:
- Encryption at-rest: we use customer-managed keys where requested; I can provide a KMS export showing key metadata and an example key-rotation policy.
- Audit trails: we can provide redacted audit-trail snapshots and a short sample of our immutable logging export for a 30-day window.
- Deployment diagram: included separately (PDF) once we confirm the appropriate level of network detail for CloudCrest.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review the attached crosswalk and flag any rows you'd like more detail on.
2) Quick intake call — I'm available 2028-06-10 between 13:00-15:30 PT.
3) We'll deliver a curated artifact package by 2028-06-13 as requested.

Can you confirm whether CloudCrest requires a Customer KMS attestation (key material proof) or if metadata and rotation logs are sufficient? That will change the packaging/ops steps.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127
Attachment: redwood-sig-crosswalk-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: FW: CloudCrest SIG intake — internal action items

Team — forwarding CloudCrest's initial intake and my reply. They want a control crosswalk and a small artifact bundle by EOD 6/13. Please see my notes inline below from the crosswalk.

Olivia's asks (condensed): control mapping, KMS proof (customer keys?), audit samples, deployment diagram.

Action items: 
- Soojin: can you confirm which artifacts we can produce without involving customers (i.e., metadata/rotation logs vs. key material)? Also, please prepare the deployment-arch-diagram.pdf draft (low-level network view showing management plane separation).
- Jasmine: please prepare redacted audit-trail-samples.zip (two examples: admin-config-change and token-issuance) and confirm retention export for 30 days.

Timeline: internal owners should sync by EOD 6/11 so I can package and send on 6/11-6/12. CloudCrest expects delivery by 6/13.

I'm marking this P1 for the intake. If either of you foresee blockers (legal/KMS), escalate to me immediately.

Thanks — MC

---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: CloudCrest SIG intake — internal action items

Marissa — quick status update from infra/security ops: 

Artifacts we can produce within 48 hours (no legal/KMS customer interaction required):
- KMS metadata export (key IDs, creation/rotation timestamps, owner tags) — kms-keyproof-export.tar (note: does not include key material).
- Audit logs: redacted audit-trail-samples.zip (admin-config-change.log, token-issuance.log) — includes event hashes and timestamps, redacted user identifiers.
- Deployment diagram (VPC and control-plane separation): deployment-arch-diagram.pdf (draft).

Potential blocker: CloudCrest asked explicitly about "customer KMS attestation (key material proof)" — we cannot provide key material. If they require cryptographic proof of key custody we should propose an alternate: either a witness attestation from our HSM vendor or a signed statement of custody plus KMS rotation logs. I recommend offering a vendor attestation + rotation logs.

I'll assemble the artifacts and a short README.md describing redaction and scope. ETA to Marissa for packaging: EOD 6/11.

— Soojin

Attachment(s): kms-keyproof-export.tar (tarball, metadata only), audit-trail-samples.zip (archive), deployment-arch-diagram.pdf (PDF)

---
From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@cloudcrest.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCrest SIG intake: request for control substantiation and onboarding artifacts

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Two quick notes: 
1) CloudCrest requires a signed NDA before we accept any non-public artifacts. I've attached our procurement-signed-nda.pdf for signature. Can Redwood countersign and return?
2) If you can provide the artifacts you described (metadata exports, audit samples, diagram) by EOD 6/12 we'll be able to move this RFP into legal review on schedule.

We can do a 30-minute call tomorrow at 14:00 PT to walk through the crosswalk — I'll send a calendar invite once the NDA is complete.

Thanks,
Olivia
Attachment: procurement-signed-nda.pdf

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@cloudcrest.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T18:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCrest SIG intake: request for control substantiation and onboarding artifacts

Hi Olivia — received the NDA (thanks). We'll countersign and return by 2028-06-12 morning.

Status and next steps: 
- Packaging: we're assembling the artifact ZIP with the items Soojin listed (kms metadata, redacted audit samples, draft deployment diagram). Jasmine and Soojin will produce the artifacts by EOD 6/11; I'll do a final review and transmit a curated package by 2028-06-12 10:00 PT.
- KMS attestation approach: we cannot share key material. We'll countersign NDA and provide: (a) KMS metadata export (included), (b) rotation logs and signed HSM vendor attestation (we'll request the vendor attestation now and include as soon as we receive it). Please confirm whether a vendor attestation + rotation logs is acceptable to CloudCrest.
- Intake call: 2028-06-10 14:00 PT no longer possible; propose 2028-06-12 at 14:00 PT. Will that work for your team?

I'll attach the crosswalk v1 and the artifact README in the package. If CloudCrest needs deeper crypto proofs we can open a short exception/RFI for a controlled live demo with legal present, but that's only if the attestation route isn't sufficient.

Best,
Marissa
Attachment(s) to follow: redwood-sig-crosswalk-v1.xlsx, artifact_package_cloudcrest_20280612.zip (planned)
